mapper.sql: id, member_id, topic_id, tag_code, tag_value, source_node_id, status, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: insert into player_topic_tag (member_id, topic_id, tag_code, tag_value, source_node_id, status, create_time, update_time) values (#{memberId}, #{topicId}, #{tagCode}, #{tagValue}, #{sourceNodeId}, 0, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}) on duplicate key update id = last_insert_id(id), tag_value = if(status = 0, values(tag_value), tag_value), source_node_id = if(status = 0, values(source_node_id), source_node_id), update_time = if(status = 0, values(update_time), update_time)
mapper.select: select from player_topic_tag where id=#{id} and member_id=#{memberId}
mapper.update: update player_topic_tag set tag_value=#{tagValue}, update_time=now() where id=#{id} and member_id=#{memberId} and status=0
update player_topic_tag set status=1, update_time=now() where id=#{id} and member_id=#{memberId} and status=0
update player_topic_tag set status=2, update_time=now() where id=#{id} and member_id=#{memberId} and status in (0,1)
mapper.select: select from player_topic_tag where member_id=#{memberId} and topic_id=#{topicId} and source_node_id=#{sourceNodeId} and status=0 order by id
select from player_topic_tag where member_id=#{memberId} and topic_id=#{topicId} and status=1 and tag_code in #{code} order by id
select from player_topic_tag where member_id=#{memberId} and topic_id=#{topicId} and status=1 order by id
